notes.title: New major update (2.4)
notes.notes:
Hi, players!

In this update you will find:
* Available the chapter "Winter and Cave"
* Improved player animations and climbing system
* Full controller support
* Published OS X version
* Fixed bugs and small improvements

Thanks for playing and reviews!

Have a nice trip!

notes.title: First big update 1.1
notes.notes:
Hi there!

What's new?
* Available the second chapter "The Lost Land" (Demo version) with various puzzles and traps!
* Fix bugs

Add to wishlist and share to friends, coming soon new update with more features and full version of second chapter!
Thanks for reviews and suggestions for improvement.

Have a nice trip!:)
